candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Register subjektov nadzora (supervised-entity register)
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative national register of supervised entities, including licensed payment institutions and e-money institutions; each entity has its own detail page (e.g. Paywiser). Primary way to enumerate the licensed non-bank payments population in Slovenia and detect new licences/withdrawals.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled HTML scrape of register index + entity detail pages; diff snapshots to detect additions/removals
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on regulator register terms
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register plačilnih institucij družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Register družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja (EMI register)
candidates.why_relevant: Dedicated EMI register maintained under ZPlaSSIED, listing authorised e-money issuers, their agents/representatives and branches. Directly enumerates the Slovenian EMI segment.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic fetch of register page and any linked list files (PDF/XLS); snapshot-diff
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search; snowballed from bsi.si register hub
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register plačilnih institucij družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja
local_language_terms_used: register družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Plačilne institucije / družbe za izdajo e-denarja držav EGP v Sloveniji (EEA passporting lists)
candidates.why_relevant: Lists EEA-passported PIs and EMIs operating into Slovenia — captures the large share of the Slovenian payments market served by foreign-licensed fintechs that would be invisible in the domestic licence register.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape both EGP list pages; join with EBA PSD2 central register for cross-validation
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register plačilnih institucij družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Nadzor nebančnih ponudnikov plačilnih storitev / Poročilo o delovanju plačilnega sistema
candidates.why_relevant: Supervisory/oversight publications on non-bank PSPs plus the recurring payment-system reports — gives aggregate volumes and structural commentary on the non-bank payments segment rather than only entity names.

queries_used: Banka Slovenije register plačilnih institucij družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja

candidates.source_name: ATVP (Agencija za trg vrednostnih papirjev) – registri in seznami, incl. MiCA/CASP
candidates.why_relevant: ATVP is the Slovenian competent authority for MiCA CASP authorisations and supervises Bitstamp Financial Services (MiFID firm, Ljubljana). Its registers and MiCA guidance are the authoritative Slovenian view of the crypto-adjacent licensed population.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape register index pages and monitor ATVP news/decisions; archive MiCA guidance PDFs
queries_used: ATVP register ponudnikov storitev v zvezi s kriptosredstvi MiCA Slovenija dovoljenje

candidates.source_name: ESMA MiCA public register of authorised CASPs
candidates.why_relevant: EU-level register of authorised CASPs and white papers; filterable by home member state, so it yields the Slovenian-authorised crypto firms and, conversely, the foreign CASPs passporting into Slovenia. Cross-check for ATVP.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download register export (CSV/XLSX) on a schedule; filter home_member_state = SI

candidates.source_name: EBA central register of payment and e-money institutions (PSD2 PIR)
candidates.why_relevant: Machine-readable EU-wide register of PIs/EMIs including Slovenian entities and their passporting footprint; better structured than the national HTML pages and good for automated change detection.

candidates.source_name: AJPES JOLP – public disclosure of annual reports
candidates.why_relevant: Slovenian fintechs/EMIs/crypto firms are mostly private d.o.o. companies with no investor-relations pages; their statutory annual reports and balance sheets are filed here. This is effectively the only systematic financial disclosure channel for this cell (73,710 company reports published for FY2025 on 05.08.2026).
candidates.legal_status: public_official_filings; free registration required, respect ToS
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Authenticated session against JOLP; look up target companies by matična/davčna številka; download PDF/table filings annually after the August mass-publication date
queries_used: AJPES JOLP javna objava letnih poročil gospodarskih družb iskanje

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovenian-language newsroom or press-release archive was located for mBills (the Slovenian mobile-wallet/mobile-payments product). Searches returned no company news channel for it.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovenian-language search combining mBills with Leanpay and Paywiser returned nothing on mBills; it may only be covered via its parent/bank-partner channels.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The domestic mobile-wallet segment is a core part of this cell; without a direct channel it must be tracked indirectly via its owning entity's disclosures and national media, which delays signal.

negative_findings.description: No Slovenia-specific structured funding-round database (rounds, amounts, investors) for fintech/payments startups was found in either language during this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: startup.si offers an investment-tagged news stream and an investor directory, but not a structured round-level dataset; searches surfaced only journalistic rankings of best-funded startups.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Funding rounds are the primary disclosure channel for unlicensed wallet/BNPL startups; without a structured source, round tracking depends on media monitoring with unknown recall.

negative_findings.description: A directly linked, standalone ATVP page listing MiCA/CASP authorisations for Slovenia was not confirmed; results pointed to ATVP's investment-services register, ATVP MiCA guidance material, and the ESMA interim/central register accessed via ATVP.
negative_findings.result_summary: Slovenian-language search for the ATVP crypto register returned the investment-services register and a MiCA leaflet PDF, plus media reporting that 24 providers may operate in Slovenia and that ATVP issued its first MiCA licence.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The Slovenian CASP population must currently be derived from the ESMA register filtered to SI rather than a national list, adding a dependency and possible lag.

negative_findings.description: No URL in this slice was fetched or liveness-tested; all URLs come from search-result metadata and site-structure inference and are supplied with confidence scores only.
negative_findings.result_summary: Discovery pass was search-driven; deterministic verification is left to the downstream pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Some deep paths (e.g. section index URLs assembled from article URLs) may redirect or 404 and should be treated as unverified rather than dead.

coverage_gaps.description: The licensed Slovenian PI/EMI population was not enumerated entity-by-entity in this pass; only Paywiser was confirmed by name from the Banka Slovenije register.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Fetch and parse the Banka Slovenije supervised-entity register and the EBA PSD2 register filtered to SI to build the complete PI/EMI actor list, then scout a source channel per entity.

coverage_gaps.description: BNPL and wallet startups beyond Leanpay and Paywiser are not mapped; no systematic Slovenian-language sweep was done for terms such as 'digitalna denarnica', 'obročno plačevanje', 'plačaj kasneje'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated Slovenian-language sweep on wallet/BNPL vocabulary plus the startup.si startup-mapa directory and the Ministry of Economy consumer-credit licence register.

coverage_gaps.description: Domestic payment infrastructure/processing vendors adjacent to this cell (Bankart, Halcom, and the Flik instant-payment scheme) were surfaced only incidentally and have no scouted source entries here.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout Bankart, Halcom and Flik corporate news pages and Banka Slovenije scheme documentation as a separate infrastructure sub-cell, to avoid overlap with the bank-focused cells.

coverage_gaps.description: No Slovenian press-release wire (e.g. STA / STA Servis or a PR distribution service used by local fintechs) was scouted, although STA appeared in results as the national news agency.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Assess STA and any Slovenian PR-distribution wires for a licensed or public feed that would give complete, dated press-release capture for this cell.

coverage_gaps.description: The single most valuable financial-disclosure source (AJPES JOLP) is behind a free registration wall, and two key media sources (Bloomberg Adria, Delo) are partially paywalled.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Decide on an access approach: register an institutional AJPES account for filings, and limit media collection to headline/date/URL metadata plus short attributed quotes.

brief: Slovenia's non-bank payments and crypto cell discloses through three distinct layers rather than through investor relations: statutory registers (Banka Slovenije's supervised-entity and EMI registers plus EEA passporting lists; ATVP for MiCA/CASP, cross-checkable against the ESMA and EBA EU registers), statutory financial filings at AJPES JOLP (which is the only systematic financial disclosure for these mostly private d.o.o. companies), and a thin but distinctive announcement layer of company blogs and local trade media. The crypto cluster is unusually prominent for a market this size — Bitstamp (now Robinhood-owned, ATVP-supervised), Eligma/GoCrypto's merchant-acceptance network anchored on BTC City, and NiceHash — and its signals arrive through corporate blogs, partner-merchant press rooms and Slovenian outlets (Bloomberg Adria, Delo, Siol, Računalniške novice) rather than filings. Unlicensed wallet and BNPL players such as Leanpay surface mainly through the startup.si ecosystem directory, industry associations (Blockchain Alliance Europe, SBCA) and interview-driven business media, so pointer sources carry disproportionate weight in this cell. Main structural weaknesses are the absence of a structured Slovenian funding-round dataset, the lack of a national CASP list independent of ESMA, and registration/paywall friction on the highest-value financial sources.
